label: Bible Study
prompt: And be ye kind one to another, _____, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
verse: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
note: One glorious KJV compound word — kindness with the heart turned all the way up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He is the Rock, his work is _____: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
verse: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
note: Moses's song calls God the Rock — the one thing in the wilderness that never shifted.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD _____ us.
verse: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
note: The Ebenezer stone from the hymn — 'hitherto' is KJV for 'this far, every step.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Which hope we have as an _____ of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
verse: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
note: The only place Scripture calls hope an anchor — moored not to the seabed but inside the veil.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not _____ again with the yoke of bondage.
verse: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
note: Liberty can be re-lost: 'entangled again with the yoke of bondage' — Paul's picture of a snagged harness.
